Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Poss Resend N Y = Indicates an application level unsolicited resend. If Cl Ord ID has not yet been seen, the cancel is treated as normal. If Cl Ord ID already exists, the resent cancel is ignored. N = (default) indicates a new cancel.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Transact Time Y Time cancel initiated/released. Required by FIX 4.2 but not used by Cboe.

Mass Cancel Inst Y At least one character must be provided (PID Filter). Contiguous characters must be specified up to total length. Truncated (unspecified) characters will default to values indicated below. 1st Character : PID Filter A = No filtering by PID is performed. F = All orders that were sent under the PID specified in On Behalf Of Comp Id (115) will be cancelled. 2nd Character : Acknowledgement Style M = (default) Individual Execution Reports are sent for each cancelled order. S = Single sent Purge Acknowledgement once all cancels have been processed. Single will contain Purge Acknowledgement Mass Cancel Id (7695) and Cancelled Order Count

Mass Cancel ID N Mass Cancel ID – This field will be echoed back in the resulting when Purge Acknowledgement second character of Mass Cancel Inst (7700) is set to ‘S’ or ‘B’. Purge requests containing a Mass Cancel ID that is currently outstanding will be rejected. Mass Cancel ID cannot end with a space. Maximum length 20 (extra characters will be ignored).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol N Symbol (upper case). Limits cancellations to only orders with the specified symbol.

Matching Unit N Matching unit number the will Purge Request be sent toward. If blank or 0, the Purge Request will be sent to all units. Incompatible with symbol- level purges, specifying both Symbol (55) and Matching Unit (25017) will cause the Purge to be rejected. Request

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order Id N To cancel a single order, enter the Order ID supplied by Cboe on the order acknowledgement. In the case of multiple changes to a single order, this will be the Order Id from the most recent acknowledgement.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: ‘Y’ Indicates an application level resend. If the Cl Ord ID does not indicate an already pending Cancel/Replace, the Cancel is treated as normal. If Cl Ord ID does indicate an already pending Cancel/Replace then the resent Cancel/Replace is ignored. ‘N’ (default) indicates a new Cancel/Replace.

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33-126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. The ‘at’ symbol and double quotes are also not allowed. Duplicate order Cl Ord IDs will be rejected1 (or ignored if Poss Resend=‘Y’).

Field.Name: ShortSellCoveredQty
Field.Description: Defines the portion of Order Qty (38) that is covered. Required if (and only if) the order has Side=5 (sell short) and Order Qty is specified on this message. Otherwise, Ignored.

Field.Name: ShortSellLongQty
Field.Description: Defines the portion of Order Qty (38) owned by the participant who placed the order. Order having Side (54) = 5 (sell short) will be rejected unless Short Sell Naked Qty + Short Sell Covered Qty + Short Sell Long Qty is equal to the Order Qty (38) and Short Sell Long Qty < Order Qty (38). Required if (and only if) the order has Side=5 (sell short) and Order Qty is specified on this message. Otherwise, Ignored.

Field.Description: N = Leave original order alone. Y = Cancel original order if replacement fails (an unsolicited Cancel report will be sent for original order in this case).
